import_dest_question: Where do you want to import the notes?
import_dest_acc_separate_desc: One staff per MIDI track/part (e.g. 4 MuseScore staves).
import_dest_acc_grandstaff_desc: All parts merged into one grand staff (treble+bass).
export_music_midi_desc: The piece's notes as a MIDI file (no analysis). For DAWs, notation editors and synthesizers.
export_music_xml_desc: Roman numerals above + real figures below. Universal format (MuseScore, Finale, Sibelius, Dorico…).
export_music_spoken_desc: Analysis written out in Italian in the figured bass, read aloud by VoiceOver. Nothing to install. Currently available in Italian only.
export_music_token_desc: Compact labels in the figured bass; requires a VoiceOver pronunciation dictionary.
language_section_hint: Your choice is saved locally and applied immediately.
preferences_subtitle: Groups settings that are not essential to the toolbar.
reset_section_tooltip: Reset preferences of the current section
toolbar_chromatic_tooltip: Chromatic modulation — Detects extended modulations (≥3 measures) without cadential preparation by analyzing chromatic content. For shorter tonicizations use together with Cadential patterns
menu_delete_measure_hint: Deletes the measure and shifts everything that follows back.
menu_insert_text_tooltip: Inserts only the text as a marker (without showing the key)
menu_apply_harmony_override_tooltip: Apply harmonic override to this beat
menu_remove_harmony_override_tooltip: Remove harmonic override from this beat
chorale_progression_label: Progression (separated by spaces, dashes or commas)
chorale_veto_rules_hint: Before settling a chord, the generator submits it to the app's checker and rejects those breaking a mechanical rule: parallels, forbidden intervals, crossings, ranges.
chorale_backstep_hint: When a chord has no way out, it reopens the previous one instead of giving up. Requires the veto.
chorale_ripasso_hint: Once the progression is finished, it re-spaces the voices of the chords still in error — this time knowing the following chord too, which writing left to right it could not know. It never changes the harmony. Requires the veto.
chorale_harmonize_soprano_title: Automatically generate roman numeral progression from the melody
chorale_no_voice1: There are no notes on the choir staff: write the melody on the soprano voice first.
chorale_melody_other_voice: The melody is there, but not on the soprano: {{quante}} notes on the {{voce}} voice. Harmonisation starts from the soprano — move the notes there (or, if you meant to harmonise a bass line, use “given bass” below).
chorale_melody_only_rests: The soprano voice holds {{quante}} rests and no notes. A deleted note stays in the list as a rest: write the melody again.
chorale_no_voice4: No voice 4 notes found on the staff.
chorale_harmonize_inner: Harmonise from an inner voice already written
chorale_inner_found: {{quante}} {{voce}} notes found — the engine will harmonise from those and generate the other three voices.
chorale_inner_none: There are no notes on the {{voce}} voice.
chorale_inner_note: An inner voice constrains the harmony as much as the soprano does, but it does not fix the inversion the way the bass does: expect more freedom in the choices.
chorale_voice_disabled: {{label}} off — stays as it is on the staff, the generator leaves it alone
chorale_regen_hint: Regenerate: only enabled voices will change
chorale_mod_title: Modulation — inserts →, then type the key (e.g. G: Bb: f#:)
confidence_enharmonic_reading: Inconsistent spelling: the symbol is read enharmonically and does not match what is written
import_dest_acc_separate_desc_n: {{count}} staves, one per part. Added to the open project.
import_mark_drums: Treat this part as percussion (drum kit)
import_dest_satb_no_drums: Not available: percussion are not pitches and do not belong in the choir.
import_drums_hint: Tap 🥁 to treat a part as percussion (channel 10 and names like “Drums” are recognised automatically).
import_unmark_drums: Treated as percussion — tap to make it a pitched part again
import_drums_hint2: Percussion and pitched parts are detected automatically (channel 10, track name): tap the label only to correct them.
import_key_from_guess: inferred from the notes (the file does not declare it); correct it from the toolbar if wrong
import_key_changes_one: plus one key change written in the file
import_key_changes_many: plus {{count}} key changes written in the file
export_music_summary_no_analysis: No analysis: all three are off.
export_music_summary_midi: MIDI carries the notes, not the analysis.
voice_cross_disable_hint: Turn it back on in Preferences → Editor
system_break_hint: Manual system break — click to remove it (⌥Enter on the measure)
note_menu_break_add: Break the system after this measure
pal_undock: Undock: it floats over the score again, and you can move it where you like
pal_dock: Dock to the left: the score narrows to make room for it
pal_search_aria: Search for a sign in the palette
pal_rest_on: You are entering RESTS — click to go back to notes  ·  R
pal_slur: Slur: select two notes and click, or drag it onto the music
pal_rit: Rallentando: drag it where it begins  ·  ⌥⇧R (click: at the caret)
pal_accel: Accelerando: drag it where it begins  ·  ⌥⇧R (click: at the caret)
pal_pat_pedal: Pedal: the pattern's notes are left ringing
pal_tr_tonal_tip: TONAL transformations (diatonic, by scale degree). Click to switch to real.
pal_tr_real_tip: REAL transformations (chromatic). Inversion and retrograde-inversion leave the key.
pal_fp: Forte piano: drag it onto the score, or select a note and click
pal_cresc: Crescendo: drag it onto the score (then stretch it by its ends), or select two notes and click
pal_dim: Drag the diminuendo onto the score (then shorten it by its ends), or select two notes and click
pal_text_write: Write a text where the playback caret is
pal_text_drag: Drag “{{s}}” onto the point in the score
pal_key_pick: Key signature to place (the major root: the relative minor shares it)
pal_key_minor: Minor mode (same signature as the relative major)
pal_key_drag: Key change to {{k}}: drag it onto the measure it starts from. From there the analysis reads in that key too (click: at the caret)
pal_key_remove: Removes the key change in the measure where the caret is
pal_key_transpose_tip: On a key change the notes already written are TRANSPOSED into the new key
pal_key_modal_tip: Modal: the notes stay where they are and the reading changes — the same music read in another mode
pal_key_leading_tip: In a minor key the leading note is raised automatically where needed
pal_time_remove: Remove the time-signature change from the measure where the caret is
pal_tempo_unit: Beat unit: the note the number refers to
pal_tempo_dotted: Dotted beat unit (worth one and a half)
pal_tempo_bpm_aria: Beats per minute of the mark to place
pal_bar_double: Double barline: drag it onto the measure where it belongs (click: at the caret)
pal_bar_repeat_start: Repeat start: drag it onto the measure the repeat goes back to (click: at the caret)
pal_bar_repeat_end: Repeat end: drag it onto the measure where the music goes back (click: at the caret)
pal_bar_repeat_both: Double repeat: one ends here and another begins (click: at the caret)
pal_measure_add: Drag it onto the measure to insert an empty measure before (click: at the caret)
pal_measure_del: Drag it onto the measure to remove (click: the one at the caret)
pal_octave_up: Sounds an octave ABOVE the written pitch: select the passage and click, or drag it onto a note (it covers the measure). The notes do NOT move — write them where they are to be read.
pal_octave_down: Sounds an octave BELOW the written pitch: select the passage and click, or drag it onto a note (it covers the measure). The notes do NOT move — write them where they are to be read.
pal_remove_here: Remove the signs at the selected point
pal_footer: Open a group and drag a sign anywhere onto the score: the group stays open all the while. The signs that apply to a measure — key, time signature, metronome mark, barlines, rall./accel. — can also be placed with a click, where the reading line is. Or: select a note and click the sign (two notes for a hairpin). On the staff, signs are moved by dragging and removed with the right button.
pal_words_dynamics: dynamic dynamics piano forte pianissimo fortissimo pp p mp mf f ff fff sf sfz rf fp accent accents hairpin hairpins crescendo diminuendo cresc dim levels
pal_words_articulations: articulation articulations staccato staccatissimo tenuto marcato accent slur slurs tie tempo rallentando accelerando rall accel curve text words dolce fine cvii position
pal_words_durations: duration durations value values note notes rest rests whole half quarter eighth sixteenth thirty-second dot dotted triplet
pal_words_patterns: pattern patterns arpeggio arpeggios accompaniment alberti wave broken block pedal resonance let ring
pal_words_transforms: transformation transformations motif motifs melodic transposition transpose inversion invert retrograde retrograde-inversion tonal real
pal_words_structure: structure key signature clef time metre meter measure measures bar bars double barline repeat repeats volta octave 8va 8vb tempo metronome bpm speed fermata
tb_restart_audio_tip: If the sound stops coming out — headphones unplugged, output changed, audio system not ready at launch — this rebuilds the engine without closing the program. Your work is untouched.
mod_suppress_tip: Ignore this automatic inference without adding any manual context
mod_tonicization_tip: Adds a local tonicisation from this beat. It fades out by itself when the harmony no longer supports it.
mod_why_tip: Shows why the analysis read this chord this way (also with ⌥+click on the label)
tb_palette_tip: Palette: durations, accidentals, dynamics, articulations, structure, patterns and transformations (open/close)
ed_trial_over: ⏳ Trial ended — <1>analysis</1> and <3>automatic realisation</3> are disabled. Editing, export, playback and printing stay available.
ed_text_hint: Double-click to edit · drag to move · right-click to remove
ed_slur_end_hint: Drag to move the end of the sign; right-click to remove it
ed_hairpin_hint: Drag to stretch the hairpin; right-click to remove it
ed_analysis_off_hint: Switch it on to see the mistakes.
motifs_tip: Detects transpositions / inversions / retrogrades of a motif (within and between voices). Purple band = model, bracket = imitation.
tonicization_add_tip: Adds a local tonicisation from this beat on. It fades out by itself when the harmonic context no longer supports it.
override_hint: Tip: open this menu with Option + right-click.
mix_reverb_send: Reverb send (type and global level from the master)
mix_delete_tip: Delete the selected ACC tracks — also with the Delete key (SATB voices cannot be deleted)
np_choose: Choose the starting tracks. You can always add more later from the mixer.
np_load_template: Load this template into the selection
rp_corpus_tip: Suggestions based on the corpus of analysed pieces
rp_save_fav: Save the current progression to favourites
rp_load_profile: Load the style profile pre-computed from 46 repertoire pieces (Bach, Dubois, etc.)
ts_write_tip: Type it, or use the wheel or the ↑↓ arrows
ts_meter_tip: Time signature — type the number, or change it with the wheel and the ↑↓ arrows
pal_dyn_drag: Drag {{s}} onto the score, or select a note and click
pal_artic_drag: {{s}}: drag it onto a note, or select the notes and click. Putting it back removes it.
pal_time_place: Time-signature change {{s}}: drag it onto the measure it starts from (click: at the caret)
pal_tempo_place: Metronome mark: drag it onto the measure it starts from (click: at the caret). Unlike a rallentando it gives the NUMBER, so the reader knows the speed.
mix_meter_stereo: Show separate left and right levels
pattern_serve_selezione: Select a chord on a track first: the pattern applies to that.
pattern_solo_tracce: Patterns apply to accompaniment tracks only, not to the choir: in the choir the four voices are four lines, and an arpeggio would have to decide how they move.
pattern_niente_terzine: Patterns cannot write triplets yet: choose a 1/16, 1/8, 1/4 or 1/2 grid.
revoice_nessuna_altra: No other voicing for this chord ({{n}} distinct notes).
pal_arp_voicing_tip: Changes the voicing of the selected chord: each press moves to the next position, and a full turn brings you back where you started. IF YOU SELECT ONLY SOME VOICES, only those move: the others stay put, and the cycle counts just the voicings actually possible (the counter shows where you are). With all four voices selected the seven-voicing cycle applies: S:3 = third on top, S:5 = fifth, S:R = root, S:7 = seventh; “auto” is the voicing the engine chooses.
pal_arp_subdiv_tip: How long each note of the arpeggio lasts. Separate from the quantize grid in the toolbar, which serves the Q button on recorded or imported notes.
transp_bb: in B♭ — trumpet, clarinet, soprano sax
transp_eb_alto: in E♭ — alto sax, E♭ clarinet
transp_bb_tenor: in B♭ 9th — tenor sax, bass clarinet
tb_concert_pitch_tip: Shows the parts at concert pitch (score in C). Unchecked, every transposing instrument reads in its own notation, key signature included. The notes in the file do not change: only how they are drawn.
copia_traccia_vuota: The track “{{nome}}” is empty: nothing to copy.
copia_traccia_fatta: Copied {{n}} notes from “{{nome}}”. Click where you want them: in the choir they land in the selected voice.
chorale_voice_off_unused: Careful: {{voce}} is off and there are notes on the staff, but the engine did not take them into account — it chose the harmony ignoring them. It will keep them, and they will almost certainly clash with the other voices. To make them actually count, tick “Harmonise from an inner voice already written” and generate again.
chorale_who_both: the soprano and the bass together
chorale_who_none: nobody — type some numerals or tick a voice already written
chorale_text_wins: The box TAKES PRECEDENCE: while it holds anything, the ticked voices are not read to choose the harmony (they still constrain the writing). Empty it to let them decide. Note: after every generation the box is filled with the result, so from the second time on it keeps regenerating that same progression.
chorale_nothing_to_do: Nothing to harmonise: type some numerals above, or tick a voice already written on the staff (melody, given bass or inner voice).
sel_voce_aggiungi: Add the {{voce}} voice to the selection
